title: No Determination | No Disruption Code | 14 Days | APPR | Delay 6�9h (7h) | Basic Aeroplan
description: ALL disruption codes are missing � no arrival code, no departure code, no cancellation code. The flight operated but was delayed 7 hours (6�<9h band observed in flight status) and no station logged any disruption information. Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210) linked to the booking. DDS has no code data to assess controllability. System polls Trip Tracer daily for up to 14 days waiting for codes to be entered. If codes never arrive after 14 days, routes to manual handling. Validates: (1) DDS correctly handles missing codes for an operated delayed flight, (2) 14-day polling window is enforced, (3) After 14 days with no code, case routes to manual review, (4) AC Wallet is NOT offered despite Basic Aeroplan linkage � No Determination cases do not trigger payment flows, (5) Agent manually investigates and determines eligibility.
